rules.cwe_name: Reliance on Undefined, Unspecified, or Implementation-Defined Behavior
rules.description: If an HTML element has two attributes with the same name but different values, its behavior may be browser-dependent.

rules.cwe_name: Incorrect Authorization
rules.description: An authorization check exists but evaluates access incorrectly.

rules.cwe_name: Off-by-one Error
rules.description: An array index is compared to be less than or equal to the 'length' property, and then used in an indexing operation that could be out of bounds.

rules.cwe_name: Expression is Always True
rules.description: If a conditional expression always evaluates to true or always evaluates to false, this suggests incomplete code or a logic error.

rules.cwe_name: Loop with Unreachable Exit Condition ('Infinite Loop')
rules.description: A 'for' loop that increments its loop variable but checks it against a lower bound, or decrements its loop variable but checks it against an upper bound, will either stop iterating immediately or keep iterating indefinitely, and is usually indicative of a typo.

rules.cwe_name: URL Redirection to Untrusted Site ('Open Redirect')
rules.description: Server-side URL redirection based on unvalidated user input may cause redirection to malicious web sites.

rules.cwe_name: Improper Encoding or Escaping of Output
rules.description: Client-side URL redirection based on unvalidated user input may cause redirection to malicious web sites.

rules.cwe_name: Improper Input Validation
rules.description: Security checks on the substrings of an unparsed URL are often vulnerable to bypassing.

rules.cwe_name: Reliance on Untrusted Inputs in a Security Decision
rules.description: Conditions that the user controls are not suited for making security-related decisions.

rules.cwe_name: Incorrect Comparison
rules.description: A security-relevant comparison checks the wrong, incomplete, or non-canonical value.

rules.cwe_name: Improper Encoding or Escaping of Output
rules.description: Client-side URL redirection based on unvalidated user input may cause redirection to malicious web sites.

rules.cwe_name: Improper Input Validation
rules.description: Prepending a backslash to an ordinary character in a string does not have any effect, and may make regular expressions constructed from this string behave unexpectedly.

rules.cwe_name: Cross-Site Request Forgery (CSRF)
rules.description: Using cookies without CSRF protection may allow malicious websites to submit requests on behalf of the user.

rules.cwe_name: Modification of Assumed-Immutable Data (MAID)
rules.description: Security-critical data assumed immutable can be modified by an attacker.

rules.cwe_name: Off-by-one Error
rules.description: An array index is compared to be less than or equal to the 'length' property, and then used in an indexing operation that could be out of bounds.

rules.cwe_name: URL Redirection to Untrusted Site ('Open Redirect')
rules.description: Server-side URL redirection based on unvalidated user input may cause redirection to malicious web sites.

rules.cwe_name: Expression is Always True
rules.description: Comparing the result of a typeof test against a string other than 'undefined', 'boolean', 'number', 'string', 'object', 'function' or 'symbol' is useless, since this comparison can never succeed.

rules.cwe_name: Inclusion of Functionality from Untrusted Control Sphere
rules.description: If the 'X-Frame-Options' setting is not provided, a malicious user may be able to overlay their own UI on top of the site by using an iframe.

rules.cwe_name: Reliance on Undefined, Unspecified, or Implementation-Defined Behavior
rules.description: If an HTML element has two attributes with the same name but different values, its behavior may be browser-dependent.

rules.cwe_name: Reliance on Untrusted Inputs in a Security Decision
rules.description: Comparing different kinds of HTTP request data may be a symptom of an insufficient security check.
